source: Frozen county-aligned Democratic two-party vote share2024; source unit fraction [0,1]. Finite sidecar values only; NaN is unavailable, not zero votes.
arithmetic: Complement = -share + 1. Normalized Democratic two-party margin = (share - .5)/.5. Float32 rounding at each operation, then double reference summary.
truth: Three-valued NOT of a null predicate remains unknown and is excluded by filter. Explicit isNull OR NOT includes the missing rows. NOT(share>.5) includes exact ties; !=.5 excludes them. These are county counts, never vote totals.
